plain_english_revision: The amendment shifts responsibility for notifying voters about defective or uncounted ballots from the absentee election manager to the local board of registrars. It also mandates that rejected ballots be delivered to the local board of registrars, who must issue written notice to voters within 10 days after each election. The sheriff is tasked with collecting all rejected ballots within this same timeframe.
candidate_position_supported: strengthening voter notification procedures and centralized oversight of rejected ballots
